statements.status_notes: Sourcegraph code-intel extension named 'thrift' (provides search-based language support for .thrift IDL files in the Web IDE) misidentified as the Apache Thrift npm library. The extension does not bundle the Apache Thrift JS runtime where the vulnerable file-handling code lives.
